notes.title: Visual assets rework
notes.content:
Dear community,

After having made the game free-to-play, we vowed to update and improve the game's state, in order to reach a new audience of players. The first order of business for us, was to improve the game's visual assets, particularly the backgrounds. 

Thanks to recent advancements in artificial intelligence and computer-aided design, we were able to rework the game's background assets with a modern and coherent approach. This does not include the characters, which were carefully crafted by @04119__snail specifically for our game, and will remain as they are.

We would like to hear your feedback on the game, as we work to continuously improve it in the near future!

With love and gratitude,

SRX Gameworks

notes.title: Free-to-play Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Community,

Today, we're thrilled to share some exciting news that marks a new chapter for "Louder Than Words". After much consideration, and an in-depth analysis of the game’s journey so far, we’ve made a heartfelt decision: "Louder Than Words" is transitioning to a Free-to-Play (F2P) model!

This decision wasn’t made lightly. We’ve always envisioned "Louder Than Words" as a game that’s accessible and enjoyable to everyone, and we believe moving to a F2P model aligns perfectly with that vision.

Here’s to a new, exciting chapter in the "Louder Than Words" story. We can’t wait to see where this journey takes us, together.

With love and gratitude,

SRX Gameworks

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

An update has been rolled out, addressing a number of script errors found while gathering feedback and viewing content made by the community! 

A big thank you to everyone involved, and especially Youtube Let's Player "Luis-san" for his thorough play-through which helped expose some of these issues!

His play-through can be found here : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SlJlrqFBLA&list=PLachUiHg1hacJvEPT1i4eQRsUV0DfFyGf
